Read in behavior files 
```{r}
library(rlang)

read_beh <- function(beh_dir, file, cols){
  beh <- read.delim(file.path(beh_dir, file))
  if(!any(cols %in% colnames(beh))){
    stop("Variables are not in data")
  }
    
beh <- beh %>%
  transmute( #keeps only cols you create
    id  = src_subject_id,
    age = interview_age,
    !!! set_names(syms(unlist(cols)), names(cols))
  )

  beh <- beh[2:nrow(beh), ] %>%
    arrange(id, age)
  beh <- beh[!duplicated(paste0(beh$id, beh$age)), ]
  
  beh <- lapply(beh, function(x) as.numeric(gsub('[\\""]', '', x)))
  beh <- as.data.frame(beh) %>%
    arrange(id, age)
  beh
}
```

Make cfa model
```{r}

get_cfa_model <- function(behav_clean){
  
  vars <- setdiff(names(behav_clean), c("id"))  # drop id or other non-item variables
  
  item_info <- tibble(var = vars) %>%
    mutate(
      bin       = str_extract(var, "(?<=_)[^_]+$"),     # text after last "_"
      item_base = str_remove(var, "_[^_]+$")           # everything before last "_"
    )%>%
    mutate(
      bin_start = as.numeric(str_extract(bin, "^[0-9\\.]+"))
    ) %>%
    arrange(bin_start) %>%
    filter(bin %in% bins_test)
  
  bins <- unique(item_info$bin)
  bins <- bins[bins %in% bins_test]
  
  
  # make model
  measurement_lines <- lapply(seq_along(bins), function(i) {
    this_bin  <- bins[i]
    vars_here <- item_info$var[item_info$bin == this_bin]
    paste0("F", i, " =~ ", paste(vars_here, collapse = " + "))
  })
  measurement_part <- paste(measurement_lines, collapse = "\n")
  print(measurement_lines)
  
  
  structural_lines <- lapply(2:length(bins), function(i) {
    paste0("F", i, " ~ F", i - 1)
  })
  structural_part <- paste(structural_lines, collapse = "\n")
  print(structural_lines)
  
  
  anchors <- item_info %>%
    group_by(item_base) %>%
    filter(n() > 1) %>%
    pull(item_base) %>%
    unique()
  anchor_lines <- c()
  for (a in anchors) {
    this <- item_info %>% filter(item_base == a)
    label <- paste0("l_", a)  # e.g., l_mefs_item1
    
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(this))) {
      # which factor corresponds to this bin?
      f_index <- which(bins == this$bin[i])
      anchor_lines <- c(
        anchor_lines,
        paste0("F", f_index, " =~ ", label, "*", this$var[i])
      )
    }
  }
  anchor_part <- paste(anchor_lines, collapse = "\n")
  print(anchor_lines)
  
  model <- paste(
    "# MEASUREMENT MODEL",
    measurement_part,
    "",
    "# STRUCTURAL LINKS",
    structural_part,
    "",
    "# (OPTIONAL) ANCHOR INVARIANCE",
    anchor_part,
    sep = "\n"
  )
  
  model
}
```

Dev plot 
```{r}
# plots predicted developmental changes in energy for a network 

plot_dev_energy <- function(og_df, pred_df, net, net_lab, sig_label = NULL){
  
  network_colors <- c(network_colors, other_colors)
  x_mid <- mean(range(pred_df$x, na.rm = TRUE))

  p <-  ggplot(og_df, aes(x = Scan_Age, y = total_energy)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.3, color = network_colors[net]) + # keep original data
    geom_ribbon(
      data = pred_df,
      aes(x = x, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
      fill = network_colors[net],
      alpha = 0.1,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = pred_df,
      aes(x = x, y = predicted),
      color = network_colors[net],
      linewidth = 1.2
    ) +
    {if(!is.null(sig_label)) 
    annotate("text",
         x = x_mid,
         y = Inf,
         label = sig_label,
         vjust = 2,        # push down from top
         hjust = 0.5,      # center horizontally
         size = 6,
         fontface = "bold")
    } +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.title   = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold")
    ) +
    xlab("Age (mo)") +
    ylab("Control Energy") +
    ggtitle(sprintf("Activate %s Brain State", net_lab))
  
  print(p)
  
  p
  
}

```

network brain plot
```{r}
brain_vec <- function(region_vec, fill_col) {
  
  atlas_df <- schaefer7_100$data %>%
    left_join(region_vec, by = "region") %>%
    dplyr::filter(hemi == "left", side == "lateral")
   atlas_df$values[is.na(atlas_df$values)] <- 0
   atlas_df$values <- as.factor( atlas_df$values)
  
  # if (length(region_vec) != nrow(atlas_df)) {
  #   stop("region_vec must have length ", nrow(atlas_df),
  #        " for left-lateral schaefer7_100$data")
  # }
  
  atlas_df$fill_grp <- atlas_df$values
  
  p <- ggplot(atlas_df) +
    geom_sf(
      aes(geometry = geometry, fill = fill_grp),
      color = "grey60",
      linewidth = 0.25
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "0" = "grey85",
        "1"  = fill_col
      ),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    theme_void()
  
  p
}

  
  
  
  

brain_net <- function(net) {
  
  net_key <- c(
    "Vis"         = "Vis",
    "SomMot"      = "SoM",
    "DorsAttn"    = "DorsAttn",
    "SalVentAttn" = "SalVentAttn",
    "Limbic"      = "Limbic",
    "Cont"        = "Cont",
    "Default"     = "DMN"
  )[net]
  
  # net_key <- net
  
  fill_vals <- c("Other" = "grey85", network_colors[net_key])
  names(fill_vals)[2] <- net
  
 p <- schaefer7_100$data %>%
    filter(hemi == "left", side == "lateral") %>%
    ggplot() +
    geom_sf(
      aes(
        geometry = geometry,
        fill = ifelse(str_detect(region, net), net, "Other")
      ),
      color = "grey60",
      linewidth = 0.25
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = fill_vals,
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    theme_void()
 p
}
```

Plot energy-behavior
```{r}

plot_en_beh <- function(og_df, pred_df, beh, color, xlab, title, sig_label = NULL){
  
   x_mid <- mean(range(pred_df$x, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  ggplot(og_df, aes(x = .data[[beh]], y = total_energy)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.3, color = color) +
    geom_ribbon(
      data = pred_df,
      aes(x = x, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
      fill = color,
      alpha = 0.1,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = pred_df,
      aes(x = x, y = predicted),
      color = color,
      linewidth = 1.2
    ) +
    {if(!is.null(sig_label)) 
    annotate("text",
         x = x_mid,
         y = Inf,
         label = sig_label,
         vjust = 2,        # push down from top
         hjust = 0.5,      # center horizontally
         size = 6,
         fontface = "bold")
    } +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.title   = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    ) +
    xlab(xlab) +
    ylab("Control Energy") +
    ggtitle(title)
}
```
